status: DRAFT - not signed, not on the blackboard, not approved for any run
plan_item: C6 (IAP_v1.17_Plan.md); review finding R-P2-5 folded in; consumed by C7 (breadth report) and C8 (breadth book prereg)
drafted_by: Claude (session v117-c6); every threshold below is a proposal for the owner, every statistic is computed by iap.research.screen, none is filled in here
hypothesis: On the multi7 in-sample sessions, at least one candidate (alpha id x horizon x model identity) has a positive net-of-cost edge at the registered size: its day-clustered net gate t and the day-clustered t of its mean net return per round trip are both at or above 2.0 with a positive net IC over at least 4 session days. Candidates that do not reach every rule are not taken to a confirmatory look; the screen itself confirms nothing.

statistic.form: iap.validation.metrics.gate_statistics (v1.17, STATS_REVISION) on the pooled test rows of EVERY walk-forward fold of the methods bundle, computed twice: gross on the scored label y, net on the cost-adjusted label y - sign(z) * cost; plus the mean of sign(z) * y - cost per scored row with its day-clustered t (n_days - 1 df)
statistic.signal: z = expected_return / beta of the fold's fitted model (the walk-forward gate's pooled signal), confidence <= 0 rows unscored
statistic.cost: CostModel.round_trip_cost_return (spread + fee, both legs) + 2 x impact at participation size.qty x unit / adv under the cost model's impact rule (sqrt, 100 bps at one ADV), as a return per row; per-session ADV from the dataset's instruments.json
statistic.folds: all in-sample folds at once; nothing per fold is a gate
statistic.r_p2_5: a candidate with target maker_fill_conditional is screened on the fill-conditional maker target (iap.research.screen.maker_fill_target: the markout of the side the alpha points to where the label order FILLED, NaN otherwise - an unfilled order is not a loss) and its label TTL must equal the cell horizon; the default target is the mid label

size.rationale: one round lot, the size the maker study and the R7 lot-size deviation trade; the owner may register another size before the screen runs

candidate_rule: every registered EQUITY alpha (iap.alpha.build_all, EQ01..EQ12) at its pinned horizon, under linear_z_v1 and, where a _z2 twin exists (EQ11 is cross-sectional and has none), under linear_z_v2; FX alphas are not in the multi7 universe and are not screened here
dataset: data/real/multi7 (the seven in-sample Nasdaq sessions 2019-01-30 .. 2020-01-30, AAPL / MSFT / QQQ); dataset_version recorded by the screen

protocol.methods_bundle: v2 at statistics revision v1.17 (iap.validation.methods): row-mass walk-forward, 4 folds, 60 s embargo, HAC auto bandwidth, day-separated, per-instrument scaling
protocol.looks: ONE ledger look per candidate, kind net_of_cost_screen, dataset-scoped (23 looks for this list); a re-run of the same prereg sha256, size, rules and bundle on the same dataset is the same identity and adds no look

acceptance.unit: per candidate; every rule is a >= test on the named statistic and every rule must hold for a pass
acceptance.reading: pass = worth ONE confirmatory look under its own signed pre-registration; fail = no confirmatory run at this size on these days; a candidate that could not be screened is not_screened and is refused like a fail

holdout_exclusions.breadth_holdout: the 2025/26 Nasdaq days for every name outside AAPL / MSFT / QQQ (docs/PORTFOLIO_BREADTH.md, the C8 holdout): never in any candidates manifest, never read by the screen; a --dataset-dir whose path contains 'holdout' is refused
holdout_exclusions.registered_holdouts: every dataset a signed pre-registration names as its holdout; their dataset_version values are listed below and the screen refuses them

dataset_version_notes.ca5d079831be4e63aa76e350bb840a29a6964c01: data/real/r7_holdout, the R7-CONFIRM-1 holdout (research/r7/r7_confirm_prereg.json); AAPL / MSFT / QQQ are spent there

ordering: No confirmatory look at any candidate of this list happens before this screen has run and its document is committed under research/breadth/screen/; the C7 breadth report (--require-screen) and the C8 pre-registration (WriteBroker.preregister(screen=), python -m iap.research run --require-screen) refuse a candidate that failed or was not screened.
what_this_does_not_claim: no promotion, no holdout read, no change to any registered alpha's fingerprint, no evidence of an edge; the screen filters the candidate list for the C8 pre-registration, which is its own signed document
open_for_owner: approve the size (100 units) and the six thresholds before the screen runs on multi7
approve the candidate rule (EQUITY alphas at their pinned horizons under both linear models)
sign-off and blackboard registration before any confirmatory run of a survivor
